mapper.select: SELECT pr.status, pr.version FROM purchase_requests pr WHERE pr.id = #{requestId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approver_department_scopes scope WHERE scope.user_id = #{approverId} AND scope.department_id = pr.department_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO request_approval_decisions ( id, request_id, approver_id, decision, reason, request_version, decided_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{decision}, #{reason}, #{requestVersion}, #{decidedAt} )
